title: Single Route
description: This report compares a single route before and after a certain time frame. The report looks at average speeds and congestion.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210412 against the pre-existing convert_old_reports.py-built page (comp names '2018'/'2023'/'2017-2023' with frozen literal dates), corrected by hand. IMPORTANT FINDING: the archive (dynamic-reports-and-route-tags.md) claims this template's dates were already fixed to Current-Year/3-Years-Ago/Trailing-3-Years relative dates in the 2026-08-11 'no fixed dates, ever' round, INCLUDING a live-verification claim — but the live DB showed zero dateFormula anywhere on any of its 3 routes. That claimed fix never actually landed. Applied here for real, matching the documented intended design (Year Over Year's own real, working formulas — startDate=>yearof / year-3year->1year / year-2year->3year — used as the reference pattern since Year Over Year's own claimed fix ALSO turned out not to be live; see report-spec-and-build-script.md). Also dropped: a Bar Graph Summary panel (measure avgHoursOfDelay) that needs a bucket-grain-parameterized expression report_build.mjs doesn't build yet (guarded, not silently wrong — see the same doc). Route/graph assignments for orphaned comp ids (comp-1/comp-3/comp-5 — old sub-routes no longer in the live route array, likely from a since-undone 'by day' narrower-window variant) were best-guessed onto their closest current equivalent, flagged via confidence where the guess is not certain.

graphs.title: Route Line Graph, Avg. Hours of Delay
graphs.why: Overlays the 3-years-ago and current-year periods as their own avg-hours-of-delay profile across the day.

graphs.title: Route Map, Avg. Hours of Delay — 3 Years Ago (by Day)
graphs.why: Matches the live page's single-route delay-by-day Map panel, re-pointed at the 3-years-ago comp (its original sub-route reference is an orphaned comp id, gone from the live route array).

graphs.title: Route Bar Graph, Hours of Delay
graphs.caption:
This bar graph and the one that follows show the daily total dating back to 2016. The bar graph above displays hours of delay by day. Red colors indicate more hours of delay, while green indicates less.

The bar graph below measures daily average speeds. The redder the color, the slower the speed for that day; green indicates faster speeds.
graphs.why: Daily hours-of-delay for the trailing-3-years window, matching the live page's own caption pairing it with the speed bar graph below. Caption's color wording updated 2026-08-13 (purple/orange -> red/green) to match the actual rdylgn color-scale fix this rebuild picks up -- the old caption described a scheme this page never renders.

graphs.title: Route Bar Graph, Speed
graphs.why: Daily speed for the trailing-3-years window — the caption's second half.

graphs.title: Speed - 3 Years Ago, TMC Grid Graph
graphs.why: Per-TMC speed grid for the 3-years-ago period.

graphs.title: Route Map, Speed
graphs.why: Every comp's speed choropleth on one Map, matching the live page's all-comps Map panel.

graphs.title: Speed - Current Year, TMC Grid Graph
graphs.why: Per-TMC speed grid for the current-year period.

graphs.title: Speed - current year compared to 3 years ago
graphs.why: Recovered directly from the live section's own comparisonSeries.combine.invert bit (anchor was the 2nd-position arm) — anchor is the 3-years-ago route, matching the original stored state exactly, not a guess.

graphs.title: Bar Graph Summary, Speed
graphs.why: One bar per comp (3 years ago / current year / trailing 3 years) — the live section's routeIds referenced 2 orphaned sub-route comps no longer in the live route array; re-pointed at all 3 CURRENT comps to match the panel's own 3-way-comparison title, since the original narrower sub-routes' exact windows aren't recoverable.

confidence.note: Route reassignment is a best guess from the panel's title, not recovered data — the original comps this fed were narrower 'by day' sub-routes that no longer exist.
